tonight.headline: 31.8 behind with only Barkley left, tonight at 18:15
body: Nothing moved today: 89.8 to JuiceJam's 121.5. You need 31.8 from Barkley alone (projected 17.4), and their Eagles D/ST plays in the same game. ESPN gives you 1%.

There's nothing to change. Barkley said he's 'good to go' and came off the injury report (Inquirer; FantasyPros). Chicago start Case Keenum with Caleb Williams officially out (Bleacher Nation, 28 Sep). Re-checked at 16:03: nothing moved since the 15:33 brief.

case.label: The script that wins
case.body: Barkley scores 32-plus and the Eagles D/ST does little against Keenum. Barkley was a full participant with the stinger (Bleacher Nation). Keenum's start points the other way on their D/ST, which is the problem.

case.label: Was the lineup wrong?
case.body: No. The lineup as set was the projection lineup (121.0 both). Golden scored 21.0 on the bench against Tate's 11.8, but Golden projected 11.4 to Tate's 11.8: a coin flip, correctly taken by projection. Gadsden's 0.0 and the 49ers D/ST's 1 are results, not lineup errors.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing you can set. Only tonight's box score.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: WHEN THE WEEK ROLLS · Downs is on waivers until Wed 01:00 Mexico City. Add him only after that, as a free agent, and only if Lloyd's clause trips
doFirst.title: If Lloyd's clause trips: drop him, add Josh Downs once he clears
doFirst.subtitle: Not armed. Downs's role is holding; the only open question is Lloyd's Week 3 touches in the archive. Never spend priority on this.

case.label: The add
case.body: Downs led the Colts with 11 targets in the 19-17 win over Houston (NBC), with Alec Pierce on IR (heel). Yahoo's Colts review has Downs and Keenan Allen combining for 11 catches, 140 yards and a TD. His falsifier (under five targets) did not fire.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Lloyd was Green Bay's third back on Thursday: 15 snaps to Brooks' 27 and Johnson's 24 (SI snap counts). Brooks and Johnson had 4 carries each. Week 2 was a tie on touches in the archive, so his clause needs Week 3's archive before it trips.

case.label: The price
case.body: Downs is on WAIVERS until Wed 01:00 Mexico City (07:00 UTC). IPADE priority never resets, so he's only an add as a free agent after he clears. Bloodsports is 6th in waiver order.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The archive shows Lloyd leading Green Bay's backs in Week 3 touches, or Josh Jacobs is reinstated (no reinstatement found, 28 Sep). If executed and Lloyd outscores Downs in two of the next three weeks, it closes WRONG.

trades.theirGainLine: Their gain is +1.7 a week on Week 3 projections: Tuten (11.0) replaces Rachaad White (9.3). Lamar scores them nothing behind Allen. With Mayfield out, White's number is likely to fall, which would widen it.

case.label: Their surplus
case.body: Re-checked on the 22:03 Monday snapshot: Lamar is at slot 20 behind Josh Allen at slot 0; McCaffrey and White start at RB (slot 2), Blake Corum (9.0) is on their bench. Allen carries a QUESTIONABLE label for a late knee hit; the Bills say only that they'll see how he progresses (RotoWire, 28 Sep). No Lamar injury news found this run.

case.label: Your gain
case.body: Lamar 20.1 against Lawrence's 16.4 on this week's projections: +3.7. Season projections on this snapshot: Lamar 269.7, Tuten 179.8 (they were 273.3 and 169.0 at 15:33, so seasonProj moves within a day).

case.label: Honest risk
case.body: On raw season totals it looks lopsided in your favour, which is why it's a longshot. Their weekly gain is small. Baker Mayfield is out at least three weeks and rookie Jalon Daniels starts (NFL.com; ESPN; Buccaneers.com, 28 Sep), which should lower Rachaad White's Week 4 number. That widens their gain on paper, but it also gives them a reason to replace White from the wire themselves, which kills the fit. If Allen's knee costs him a game, Lamar stops being their surplus and the deal dies.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Team 13 start a second real back over White, drop or trade a quarterback, or Lamar lands on a Baltimore report. Don't re-send it. Respond only if they open the conversation.
